track_selection: metadata hasMotion==TRUE and hasGNSS==TRUE, non-empty motion.csv and events.csv

units.dryad_documentation: Dryad API dataset record (datasets/dryad/docs/dryad_api_dataset.json) gives no unit for motion.csv columns (Verified by reading abstract/methods). Column names (accelWithG, rotRateAlpha/Beta/Gamma, interval) match the W3C DeviceMotionEvent API (acceleration, accelerationIncludingGravity in m/s^2, rotationRate alpha/beta/gamma in deg/s, interval in ms); the methods text says the first app is a web-application retrieving acceleration, rotation rate and orientation (Inferred mapping to DeviceMotionEvent).
units.accel_unit_conclusion: m/s^2 if accelWithG magnitude median is ~9.8 and the (accelWithG - accel) magnitude median is ~9.8 (see numbers; Verified from data)

gyro_unit_evidence.interpretation_rule: If the data were rad/s, the raw Dryad median would be of the same order as the training walking median (ratio ~1). A ratio near 57.3 means the values are in deg/s. Per-device spread >> 1 would indicate mixed units across devices.

pipeline.walk_interval: events.csv testStart..testEnd (ms), samples outside are not windowed
pipeline.timestamps: motion.ms (device ms); stable sort, exact duplicate ms dropped (first kept)
pipeline.resample: linear interpolation to 50 Hz grid, grid point valid only if bracketing observed samples are <= 100.0 ms apart
pipeline.window: 128 samples, stride 64 (50% overlap), all 128 grid points valid
pipeline.under_coverage: window dropped if < 64 observed samples fall inside its time span

resolution_note: Dryad values are rounded to 0.1 (see accel_resolution_step); training data are not. Quantisation effect on features is not measured here (Inferred small for walking, may matter for stationary).

modelB_predictions_on_dryad_genuine_walk.by_subject_os_speed_note: smartphone_position is 'hand held' for all 151 motion tracks (Verified), so no placement split exists
